message.content: {"items": [{"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "The combined sensor bias and speed step structure achieves the lowest RMSE among all passing models, indicating the best fit to the observed position deviations while maintaining parsimony relative to more complex models.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP,ACTUATOR_DELAY)", "rationale": "This model achieves an RMSE nearly identical to the best two-factor model, suggesting that actuator delay may contribute marginally but does not significantly improve fit beyond sensor bias and speed step.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "Listed again as a distinct candidate due to its strong individual performance and simplicity compared to higher-order combinations.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "SENSOR_BIAS", "rationale": "Sensor bias alone provides a low RMSE and is the simplest single-factor explanation for the consistent offset between nominal and observed positions.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "This three-factor model performs comparably to the best two-factor model, indicating that velocity offset may be a secondary contributor alongside sensor bias and speed step.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET)", "rationale": "The combination of sensor bias and velocity offset yields a low RMSE, suggesting both factors may jointly explain the observed trajectory deviations.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,ACTUATOR_DELAY)", "rationale": "This model matches the RMSE of sensor bias alone, implying actuator delay does not add explanatory power beyond sensor bias for this evidence window.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}]}
